programs.summary: Mercuryo crypto debit-card product for spending crypto-funded fiat balances through a virtual Mastercard. Mercuryo's April 2025 Ledger Live integration identifies Quicko Sp. z o.o. as issuer and Mastercard as the network; the product itself was already part of Mercuryo's 2024 product line.

Crypto payment card integrated with Kolo's wallet services for crypto-funded everyday spending. Current Kolo terms identify card services as provided in collaboration with Signify Holdings Inc. / Rain Cards, while the precise issuer role is not inferred from that collaboration wording.

Non-custodial crypto account and debit-card product with virtual and physical spending, Apple Pay / Google Pay, personal IBAN functionality and crypto-to-fiat account funding. Current first-party material does not clearly identify the regulated card issuer, so no issuer is inferred.

providers.summary: Issuer identified by Mercuryo for the Spend virtual card integrated with Ledger Live.

relations.scope_note: Mercuryo's Ledger-compatible Spend launch explicitly identifies Quicko Sp. z o.o. as issuer for the virtual card offered to EEA users at that launch.
Mercuryo describes Spend as a Mastercard crypto debit card. The 2025 Ledger integration and current support material both identify Mastercard acceptance.

Current Kolo Terms state that Card Services are provided in collaboration with Signify Holdings Inc. and link that provider to Rain Cards. This records the evidenced card-service relationship without assigning Rain an issuer role.
Kolo's first-party card material describes Kolo Card as Mastercard-backed for its current EEA/Ukraine availability. No issuer is inferred from network branding.

events.title: Mercuryo integrates Spend with Ledger Live
events.description: Mercuryo announced Spend availability inside Ledger Live for eligible EEA users, identifying the product as a Mastercard crypto debit card issued virtually by Quicko Sp. z o.o. This event records the Ledger distribution milestone rather than claiming the product originated on this date.
